name: zinterp_context_dump_var_entry
description: zInterp_Context::DumpVarEntry logs one zInterp_VarEntry according to its recovered type tag.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
The type-2 string branch intentionally preserves the assembly-visible source-shape bug where *charPtr is passed to a %s format, so varargs receives an int rather than the string pointer.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4c1ab0 validates the null-entry early return, type 0 int dereference and log format, type 1 float dereference promoted to double and log format, and type 2 byte dereference passed to the char* log format.
The native smoke verifies null handling and raw varargs payloads for int, float, and type-2 entries without formatting through printf.
